i really wanted canva’s carousel studio to be the one 😮‍💨
the pitch is good: it automates the whole carousel, words and design both, and carousels genuinely take forever to make. so i tested it properly before writing it off.
it’s a no from me. the short version:
▪️the credits “roll over,” except mine sat at zero after a single use. so it’s another $10 a month for the subscription pile.
▪️the copy it writes is generic. fine for a vague “lessons i learned at 30” post, nowhere near enough if you actually have a niche.
▪️the templates only let you touch colours and fonts. placement and composition? still you, back on canva anyway.
so here’s what i’d do instead (full breakdown’s in the slides):
✔️build your own brand template in canva once. two fonts, one serif one sans, sorted.
✔️and if you want enhance your writing, bring your own points first, then let it tighten your words. never let AI be your voice and personality.
that’s really the whole thing. AI works with your voice, not in place of it.
save this for the next time carousel studio tempts you, and follow @be_brout for more marketing mythbusting. we test the hacks so you don’t have to.
